verses.1: Praise the LORD. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the company of the upright and in the assembly.
verses.2: Great are the works of the LORD, studied by all who delight in them.
verses.3: Glorious and majestic is his work, and his righteousness stands forever.
verses.4: He has made a memorial of his wondrous deeds, gracious and compassionate is the LORD.
verses.5: He provides food for those who fear him, and he remembers his covenant forever.
verses.6: He has declared the strength of his works to his people, to give them the inheritance of the nations.
verses.7: The work of his hands is truth and justice, all his commandments are trustworthy.
verses.8: They stand forever and ever, established in truth and uprightness.
verses.9: He has sent redemption to his people. He has decreed his covenant forever; holy and awesome is his name.
verses.10: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD. Good understanding is for all who do it; praise of him stands forever.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: "Praise the LORD" is a heading or call to worship, but since the psalm is in the voice of an individual, it is rendered as a call embedded in the first line rather than as a separate heading.
- v. 10: "The beginning of wisdom" follows the Hebrew "re’shit chokhmah," which is a classic Hebraic expression. "Praise of him stands forever" reflects "tehillato ‘omedet la’ad," where "tehillah" is "praise" or "glory."

[1] Praise the LORD. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the company of the upright and in the assembly.

[2] Great are the works of the LORD, studied by all who delight in them.

[3] Glorious and majestic is his work, and his righteousness stands forever.

[4] He has made a memorial of his wondrous deeds, gracious and compassionate is the LORD.

[5] He provides food for those who fear him, and he remembers his covenant forever.

[6] He has declared the strength of his works to his people, to give them the inheritance of the nations.

[7] The work of his hands is truth and justice, all his commandments are trustworthy.

[8] They stand forever and ever, established in truth and uprightness.

[9] He has sent redemption to his people. He has decreed his covenant forever; holy and awesome is his name.

[10] The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD. Good understanding is for all who do it; praise of him stands forever.

---

- v. 1: "Praise the LORD" is a heading or call to worship, but since the psalm is in the voice of an individual, it is rendered as a call embedded in the first line rather than as a separate heading.
- v. 10: "The beginning of wisdom" follows the Hebrew "re’shit chokhmah," which is a classic Hebraic expression. "Praise of him stands forever" reflects "tehillato ‘omedet la’ad," where "tehillah" is "praise" or "glory."
